description:
fixtures/00596_special_forms_three_spellings_agree.fz (one main/0 chaining twelve if/case/cond/with constructs; added by fz-p8p.28) takes ~14s locally and times out (20s) on CI for run/interp/build, so CI is red for every PR from #248 up (run 36416532358).

## Cause (verified at bb2262ce8)
Every branchy construct lowers to one shared resume entry (jobs/body.rs ~2834-3023); entry ids decrease along every edge, so the graph is acyclic and linear in size. Three walkers re-walk a join target once per arriving branch, with no memo, so k constructs in a row cost ~2^k walks:
- type analysis: deliver_tail_value -> analyze_entry (jobs/semantic.rs:1002, 388)
- runtime demand: destination_demands -> collect_entry_external_demands -> collect_entry_live_demands (jobs/runtime_demand.rs:1641, 1309, 1364)
- executable facts: destination_need -> collect_entry_callsite_needs (executable_facts.rs:649, 550)
Already once-per-entry: native.rs EntryFns, artifact.rs collect_reachable_entries, the interpreter.

Shrink (interp wall): one kind of construct 0.15s; two kinds 0.15s; three kinds 0.55-1.8s; all four 13.4s. The slowest AnalyzeActivation(main/0) goes 0.007s -> 3.8s.

## Design (approved; proposal page ../fz-p8p.31.html)
A walk's answer depends only on (entry, what flows in), and every recorder merges by union, so a repeat walk adds nothing. Each walker keeps a table for one walk: (entry, input) -> answer. A repeat returns the stored answer.
- type analysis: key (entry, scope from entry_scope); answer = return evidence. The table replaces the reachable_entries HashSet and its threaded parameter; ActivationAnalysis.reachable_entries is read from the table's keys.
- runtime demand: key (entry, outgoing demand); answer = the entry's external demands.
- executable facts: key (entry, outgoing need); answer = the tuple arity.
Rejected: merging the scopes at a join (column-wise union invents combinations; semantic-fixpoint.md forbids it for rows, and it changes published facts).

## Removal ledger
- every repeated walk, in all three walkers
- reachable_entries HashSet + its parameter through analyze_entry/analyze_branch/analyze_tail/deliver_tail_value

## Done when
- --dump activations and canon(BackendProgram) are byte-identical base vs change for every fixture; no pin moves
- each walker reports entries walked as one telemetry measurement (following the existing pattern); a test drives a small if/case/cond/with chain through the real front end and pins that count at a value predicted by hand before building
- 00596 analyzes main in milliseconds and passes inside CI's limit; the fixture matrix passes on run, interp and build
title: Walk each join once: three entry walkers re-walk a join per arriving branch
